messages:
Ava L: Heads-up — Primera onboarding blocked: admin invite returns "quota_limit" when adding 75 seats (org cap 50). Renewal in ~25 days, flagging for CS + AM.
Diego R: Ticket #8765 opened with logs. They are on a paid starter plan; billing contact is contracts@primera.io. Link: https://tickets.internal/8765.
Sofia M: Can we do a short-term cap bump so they can finish setup and we avoid a stalled renewal? Suggest +40 seats for 10 days.
Diego R: Support repro: `POST /orgs/primera/seats {count:75}` -> 403 `quota_limit`. Ops approval required.
Ava L: Proposed plan:
- CS owner: Ava L to own exec comms
- Support owner: Diego R (ticket & logs)
- Ops: temporary cap increase to 90 seats for 10 days
- AM: Sofia to lead renewal outreach + goodwill credit if go-live delayed
Agree?
ops-bot: Provisioning request queued: increase seat cap for org `primera-prod` -> 90 for 10 days. Request ID req-9917.
Sofia M: I'll draft the renewal outreach: acknowledge issue, offer 10% credit if onboarding pushed >7 days, propose a joint admin session. Sending draft by EOD.
Diego R: ETA on config change from eng: patch in 5h, but ops cap lift would be faster if approved.
Ava L: Marking as high priority due to renewal size (~$48k ARR). If cap lift not completed within 2h escalate to eng on-call.
ops-bot: Request req-9917 completed: cap increased to 90. Completed by ops-user at 2025-03-02T14:05:00Z.
Sofia M: Great — scheduling admin session for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Will send outreach after cap lift confirmed.
Diego R: Closing loop in ticket; will paste customer acceptance here when they confirm.
Ava L: Thanks team. Keeping thread open until we have renewal outreach sent and customer confirms admin access.
